part2.question: Describe a food that people eat on special occasions/events

segments.v: I want to talk about bánh chưng. It is a traditional food that Vietnamese people eat at Tết. Tết is the Lunar New Year and it is the most important holiday in Vietnam. Bánh chưng is made from sticky rice, green beans and pork. People wrap it in green leaves and make it square. Then they boil it for about ten hours. My family often makes bánh chưng at my grandparents' house. We sit around the fire at night and talk. People eat bánh chưng at Tết because it is a tradition. There is a legend about a prince who made this cake to show thanks to his father and the earth. The square shape is the earth. I love bánh chưng because it reminds me of my family.
